name: What types of tiles are best suited for kitchen floors?

mainEntity.name: What types of tiles are best suited for kitchen floors?

acceptedAnswer.text: For kitchen floors, durable and water-resistant tiles are ideal. Porcelain tiles are a popular choice due to their high durability, low porosity, and resistance to stains and scratches, making them excellent for high-traffic areas. Ceramic tiles are also a good option, offering versatility in design and good performance. Natural stone tiles like granite or slate provide a luxurious look but require more maintenance and sealing. We can help you select the best option based on your lifestyle and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Durable and water-resistant tiles like porcelain and ceramic are best for kitchen floors. Natural stone is also an option but requires more maintenance.
